name: Saudi Qaid Transport Company
verdict: Saudi Qaid Transport is a private Makkah bus company chaired by Salah Qaid bin Qaid. Nothing found.
note: Makkah bus-transport company founded in 2015 (hajj/umrah, school, tourist and sports-club transport; qaid.sa). On the sponsors' logo list at alhazem.sa and on several other Roshn-league shirts. Chairman of the board Salah Qaid bin Qaid (Hajj & Umrah Forum participant profile, January 2024). No state body or fund found in the chain, and no human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03).
